name: mr-rao
tagline: Convert PDFs and Office files to Markdown with PII stripped
description: mr-rao converts PDF and Office documents to Markdown while stripping personally identifiable information — a redaction-rebuild rather than a cover-up, with 859 tests and Sigstore-signed releases. The pipeline is built for document workflows that must ship clean, safe Markdown downstream (RAG, archiving, publishing) without leaking names, emails, phone numbers, or other PII that sits inside the original files.
highlights: PDF/Office to Markdown conversion with PII removed
Redaction rebuild rather than simple black bars or cover-ups
859 tests covering the conversion and redaction pipeline
curatorNote: Document-to-Markdown tools are everywhere now, but almost none redact PII as part of the conversion. mr-rao's rebuild-not-cover redaction, 859 tests, and signed releases make it the safe default for document pipelines that handle sensitive data.
